documents.title: Board Meeting - Financial Results/Other business matters

analysis.summary: During the Q1 FY27 conference call, Sonam Limited reported strong operational performance with a 75.65% year-on-year increase in revenue from operations to Rs. 6,656.96 lakhs, an EBITDA of Rs. 538.45 lakhs, and a PAT of Rs. 300.15 lakhs. Management highlighted the successful launch of new innovative clock models, expanded distribution, and maintained a capacity utilization of 60% to 70% for the quarter.

guidance.claim: Management guided that the full-year growth will be 25% to 30%.
guidance.quote: you have given the guidance that full-year guidance will be 25% to 30% growth.

guidance.claim: Management stated that revenue for the next quarter is expected to be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.
guidance.quote: For the next quarter we hope that revenue will be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.

guidance.claim: Management stated that revenue growth guidance for financial year 2027 will increase 25% to 30%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the 1st Quarter of FY27 reflected deadly demand across the product portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: The 1st Quarter of FY’27 has been an increasing start to the financial year, reflecting strong operational performance, deadly demand across our product portfolio and our continuing commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the positive market response to new products has been encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: The positive market response to this new product has been encouraging and strengthens our confidence in our long-term growth strategy.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that exports have been impacted due to an increase in price.
demand_outlook.quote: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that export demand has been affected due to logistic problems.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49%, reflecting our continued focus on operation efficiency, disciplined cost management and sustainable profitability.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that margins are fluctuating due to daily increases and decreases in raw material prices.
margins_costs.quote: Margin side is fluctuating because daily raw material price is increasing and decreasing. So, the margin is fluctuating a bit.

margins_costs.claim: During FY26, revenue from operations increased by 64.21% year-on-year to Rs. 171 crores.
margins_costs.quote: During the year, revenue from operations increased by 64.21% year-on-year to Rs. 171 crores.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA stood at Rs. 1509 lakhs, registering a growth of 12.31% while PAT increased by 15.63% to Rs. 732 lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at Rs. 1509 lakhs, registering a growth of 12.31% while profit after tax increased by 15.63% to Rs. 732 lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: Management explained that market competition and raw material price increases impacted margins.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, sir, because market’s competition and revenue has increased, but margin has not increased because of so many problems in raw material price increase and this situation of war in geographies.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the current capacity utilization is 60% to 70% on a quarter-to-quarter basis.
Management mentioned that they have a lot of corporate orders and a good order book.
orders_capacity.quote: We also have a lot of corporate orders. We have a good order book.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated there are no requirements for additional borrowing to fund future growth at present.
Debtors for 2024-25 were Rs. 10 crore and for 2025-26 were Rs. 6.73 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: 2024-25 debtors is Rs. 10 crore and 2025-26, debtors is only Rs. 6.73 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that cash flow is higher and 70% to 80% of business is in advance.
capital_allocation.quote: No. our cash flow is more and our presence in market, our value is like, we are working in 70% to 80% in advance.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted a slight impact on exports due to increasing prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management cited the situation of war in geographies and raw material price increases as factors affecting margins.
risks_headwinds.quote: margin has not increased because of so many problems in raw material price increase and this situation of war in geographies.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that due to the war scenario, the freight cost has increased.
risks_headwinds.quote: Due to this war scenario, the freight cost has increased.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated its intention to develop items in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 during the year 2027-28.
management_commitments.quote: So, our segment, our market planning is we will sell clock in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 and develop such items in this year, 2027-28.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to test online platforms like Amazon, Flipkart and Myntra for two, three months before starting in full force.
management_commitments.quote: We will check for two, three months that how much goods are returned to us and how much damage we are facing. After that, we will start in full force.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
